models.classification_baseline: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression, C=1.0, max_iter=1000; target delta>gain_epsilon
models.regression_baseline: DecisionTreeRegressor, max_depth=3, min_samples_leaf=20, random_state=42; target delta
models.heuristic: rerank smallest RRF top1-top2 score margin first; query-ID tie break
models.preprocessing: fit on routing training folds only
models.disagreement_heuristic: rerank smallest BM25/dense top-20 Jaccard first; query-ID tie break

bootstrap: 1000 paired duplicate-group resamples of fixed policy outcomes; no refitting or budget reselection
